landing.title: The modern way to move, earn, and operate rides.
landing.subtitle: Yala brings rider booking, driver earnings, live tracking, safe payments, and admin operations into one polished platform built for Mauritania.
landing.servicesTitle: Built for riders, drivers, and operators.
landing.rideText: Fast rider booking with live map, private calls, tips, payments, and ratings.
landing.deliveryText: A future-ready service lane for local deliveries, errands, and city logistics.
landing.driverText: Driver dashboard with online mode, trip requests, navigation, earnings, and payouts.
landing.downloadTitle: Open Yala from your home screen.
landing.downloadText: Test the rider and driver apps on the same Wi-Fi today, then package the platform for public mobile distribution when production hosting is ready.
landing.verifiedText: Admin approval, National ID, driver documents, and automatic expiration checks.
landing.privateCallingText: Drivers and riders use a platform number instead of exposing personal numbers.
landing.emergencyText: Police, ambulance, and fire contacts are available from rider and driver screens.
landing.testimonialsTitle: Built for confidence on every side of the marketplace.
landing.driverCtaTitle: Turn your car into a professional earning tool.
landing.driverCtaText: Drivers can submit documents, go online after approval, receive trips, navigate automatically, track daily earnings, and withdraw through local payout methods.

settings.privacyDescription: Location, phone privacy, account data, and platform policies.
settings.helpDescription: Get help with rides, drivers, payments, documents, and blocked accounts.
settings.safetyNumbersDescription: Tap from a phone to call local emergency support.
settings.logoutDescription: Sign out from this device and return to the secure login screen.
